summary: Two bodies that touch only along a line were joined into one on SolidCraft's truck kernel (#168): an r 10 coin 3 thick and, on top of it, a ring r 10..15 from z = 3 to 6, which meet only along the circle r 10 at z = 3. They share no area, so the union is two separate solids. The triage comment's straight-edge variant, a box with a second box on top touching it along one edge, gave an error. Both are checked as two lumps and the sum of the volumes.

cases.name: coin_and_ring_touch_along_a_circle
cases.note: Coin r 10, h 3; ring r 10..15 over z 3..6; union.

volume.formula: pi*10^2*3 + pi*(15^2 - 10^2)*3: two solids touching along a circle

cases.name: boxes_touch_along_an_edge
cases.note: A 10 x 10 x 3 box and a second one on top of it from x = 10, touching it along the edge x = 10, z = 3; union.

volume.formula: 2*10*10*3: two solids touching along an edge
